title: Election candidacy fact row
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/elections/elections_candidacies.parquet. ADR-0035 S.1 splits per-contest candidacy facts away from dim_persons while keeping candidacy_key byte-equal to election_results.entity_id for candidate-* observations.

x-changelog.description: Initial S.1 candidacy fact schema. Adds candidacy_key -> person_id bridge plus per-contest party, rank, vote, and reservation/party-type attributes moved out of dim_candidates.
Widen candidacy_key and ballot_serial to three digits for large historical candidate fields, anchored by Karnataka 1985 Belgaum.

EGC-B2 Option 1: reuse the candidacy model for Lok Sabha (PC) candidates. Add optional pc_id FK -> dim_pcs.pc_id; relax ac_id from required to nullable; widen candidacy_key pattern to also accept the IN-PC-<delim>-<state>-<no>- body. Exactly one of ac_id / pc_id is set per row (grain dispatched at read time). Additive + relaxing only; existing AC rows are unchanged.

candidacy_key.description: PK. The retired candidate_id / current election_results.entity_id for candidate-* observation rows. AC body: IN-<state>-AC-<delim>-<no>-...; PC (Lok Sabha) body: IN-PC-<delim>-<state>-<no>-...

ac_id.description: FK -> dim_acs.ac_id. Set for Assembly (AC) candidacies; null for Lok Sabha (PC) candidacies, where pc_id is set instead. Exactly one of ac_id / pc_id is non-null.

pc_id.description: FK -> dim_pcs.pc_id. Set for Lok Sabha (PC) candidacies; null for Assembly (AC) candidacies, where ac_id is set instead. Exactly one of ac_id / pc_id is non-null.

election_id.description: ECI event id / period_label, e.g. AcGenApr2021.

ballot_serial.description: Position on the ballot when available; current Section-10 path uses rank as a stand-in.

rank.description: Final vote-rank within the contest. 1 = winner.

votes_polled.description: Candidate votes. Mirrors candidate-votes-polled observation for convenient joins; null only when the source omitted the vote count.

vote_share_pct.description: Candidate vote share percentage. Mirrors candidate-vote-share-pct observation for convenient joins.

won.description: True iff rank = 1 for the contest.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet. Same ECI citation row as the candidate observations.

party_short_raw.description: Verbatim upstream party short string used as UI fallback when party_id resolves to parties.IN.UNK.

constituency_type.description: Seat reservation category for this candidacy/contest. Null when not declared.

party_type.description: ECI 5-bucket party classification for this candidacy. Null when not declared.
